svg.text: 37 firms in 18 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 207 firms, 591 interlocks, 19 components (largest 170). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 86 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
